The V-C55 registry negative check expects non-Member+ selections to be refused. Since 588dc3f0 and the CTR-012 2026-09-17 amendment, any active user may be a member, and only archived people are refused. The walkthrough should check the archived-person refusal and the Administrator-only page gate instead.

sharedFileRequests.request: Approver group still says 'Members must be Member+ users', and Approval request says 'the Contract's Owner' cancels. Since the CTR-012 2026-09-17 amendment, members and approvers may be any active user including Business Users, and the canceller is the Legal Owner.
V-C55 negative check 'Non-Member+ selections ... are refused' no longer matches CTR-012 (2026-09-17). Replace it with the archived-member refusal and the Administrator-only settings gate.
